## Ornithology Week 5 Practice Problems: Flight & Physiology

1) Contrast Bernoulli Lift and Newtonian Lift. 

2) Why is $V_{MR}$ (speed for maximum distance per unit energy) different than $V_{MP}$ (speed with minimum energy use per unit time) for flying birds?
    
    a) $V_{MP}$ minimizes the power necessary to stay aloft but results in a lower speed and less distance covered per unit time
    b) $V_{MR}$ increases both profile power and parasitic drag relative to $V_{MP}$ 
    c) $V_{MR}$ maximizes distance per unit energy
    d) all of the above
   
3) How is metabolic scope related to basal metabolic rate and active metabolic rate?

4) Contrast torpor, hypothermia, and hibernation, with avian examples of each. 

5) Define thermoneutral zone.

6) Birds share two-directional airflow with other vertebrates (**T**, **F**, or **It Depends**)  

7) Wing aspect ratio is maximized when body weight is low relative to wing area (**T**, **F**, or **It Depends**)

8) How are the pectoralis, supracoracoideus, and triosseal canal functionally related? 

9) Nitrogenous waste in birds is more concentrated (in terms of mL per unit $H_20$) than in humans (**T**, **F**, or **It Depends**)

10) Describe an experiment to test whether a sand grouse's plumage is an adaptation to hyperthermia.
